system.description:
Cursed item (seems Boots of Elvenkind or of Speed). In a fight they start you dancing: speed 0, Disadvantage on attacks, and attacks against you have Advantage. Make a Will save at the end of each turn to stop for the encounter.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
Advantage on Stealth checks made while moving.

Rarity: Uncommon
